description: Recorded Fashion-MNIST development results from the August 2026 assimilation experiments. These are not outputs of experiment.py. Read README.md for protocol differences and limitations.

protocol.evaluation: last 2000 indices; repeatedly inspected during development and used for configuration selection
protocol.teacher: 784 -> 64 -> 32 -> 10, ReLU, Adam, 40 epochs, batch 256, learning rate 0.001
protocol.validation: No separate validation split in these historical runs
protocol.source: A0, A3, A4, A6 micro and A7 experiment reports and saved result/checkpoint files, checked against those files when preparing Chapter 8. Private intermediate checkpoints are not required by the public example.

runs.label: Fitted interfaces
runs.note: A3 trained its digital encoder through a first-stage additive reader against fitted activation codes. No complete end-to-end proxy accuracy was measured. Lane epochs: 10/10/10.

runs.label: Learned interfaces
runs.note: Base configuration selected over wider second interface by evaluation accuracy. Joint training also updated A3's warm-started encoder. Proxy epochs: 40. Lane epochs: 20/10/10.

runs.label: Smaller interfaces
runs.note: 7x7 local input windows, hidden width 32. Cold start, 60 proxy epochs. Not a controlled comparison of interface width alone.

runs.label: Larger input encoder
runs.note: Selected h64w11 encoder: sixteen overlapping 11x11 windows, 64 hidden units per position. Cold start, 60 proxy epochs.

accounting: Synapse payload = 2 bytes per differential/magnitude pair in an inference pack. Encoder weights and biases = 4 bytes each. Excludes metadata, activations, read caches and software overhead. Historical accuracy describes live emulator banks, not independently evaluated packed exports.

shared_convolutional_assimilation.note: Recorded assimilation-2 B-series result, separate architecture and protocol; included only to qualify transfer generality.

masked_denoising_learned_interface.note: Recorded assimilation-7 S0/S0b masked-slot completion with U(0,1) context retention; no local lane teaching in this screen. These are completion rates, not image classification accuracies.
